item.title: ‘Bombshell’ disclosures on State Police sergeant upend Phan murder retrial
item.description: LOWELL — The murder retrial of the Phan brothers came to an abrupt halt on Tuesday when a judge stopped jury selection and released the 12 jurors already seated, citing the need to review newly surfaced information about a State Police sergeant accused of causing a fatal 2023 crash with alcohol in his system.

item.title: Super Bowl LX excitement at Tewksbury’s Building Blocks Preschool
item.description: What a touchdown of a day! Building Blocks Preschool in Tewksbury turned into the ultimate Patriots fan zone Friday, with kiddos decked out in red, white, and blue wearing their favorite Patriots attire. From football tosses to goalpost challenges, every classroom was buzzing with team energy.

item.title: Westford Academy swimmers show Patriots pride
item.description: PATRIOTS PRIDE The Westford Academy varsity boys swim team members showing their ‘Patriots pride’ before their North Sectional Meet on Sunday at Boston University. Later in the day, the New England Patriots will play Seattle in the Super Bowl.

item.title: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson surprises Massachusetts boy with rare health challenges
item.description: TreVeyon Henderson is supporting a Massachusetts boy who faces unimaginable health challenges. The youngster hopes he can meet the Patriots' promising rookie running back someday to thank him for an unexpected gift.
